description: This file defines the DeleteModelEvent class, which extends AbstractModelEvent, and is part of the Goteo event system. It handles deletion events for models, encapsulating information such as the model instance and conditions for deletion.

classes.name: DeleteModelEvent
classes.description: Represents a deletion event for a model, storing the model and deletion conditions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DeleteModelEvent with a model instance and deletion conditions.

methods.name: getWhere
methods.description: Returns the conditions used for deletion.
